title: Replace a request response without a backend

prompts.en: Open {url}. The page calls an API and shows what it received. Add a rule that replaces that API's response with the JSON {\"source\":\"mock\",\"token\":\"MOCK-1\"}, then reload the page and confirm it now shows the replaced payload. Remove the rule when you are done, then close the browser session.
prompts.zh-CN: 打开 {url}。页面会调用一个 API 并显示收到内容。添加一条规则，把该 API 的返回替换为 JSON {\"source\":\"mock\",\"token\":\"MOCK-1\"}，然后刷新页面，确认显示的是替换后的内容。完成后删除该规则，再关闭浏览器会话。

site.label: the un-mocked page reached the real backend
the page received the replaced payload after the rule was added
the origin server was contacted once, and only for the un-mocked load

response.label: the rule was created with an id
the rule carries the replacement payload
